records.title: Improving Reasoning Capabilities in Small Models through Mixture-of-layers Distillation with Stepwise Attention on Key Information
records.reason: The method distills reasoning behavior into smaller models using stepwise attention to improve reasoning accuracy. The abstract reports capability gains, not an inference-efficiency technique or cost measurement.

records.title: SDAR-VL: Stable and Efficient Block-wise Diffusion for Vision-Language Understanding
records.reason: SDAR-VL focuses on efficient/stable training and convergence for vision-language diffusion; training efficiency is outside the stated inference/serving scope.

records.title: Harnessing Consistency for Robust Test-Time LLM Ensemble
records.reason: CoRE improves robustness of LLM ensembles against inconsistent signals; the abstract presents quality/robustness rather than reduced inference resources or serving cost.

records.title: Attribution, Citation, and Quotation: A Survey of Evidence-based Text Generation with Large Language Models
records.reason: The paper surveys evidence-based generation and evaluation metrics for LLM reliability; it does not concern inference/serving efficiency.
